text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we've come to a cafe to film the
TV show
Kawakami Princess was
approached about after
the Japanese
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...There's not a single customer in sight.
It's like a
ghost town!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Good to see you again! Thank you for
agreeing to
take part.

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
As mentioned in the materials I sent you,
today's
show will be held in a discussion
format. I've
reserved the whole cafe so
we can really explore
your appeal as a
racer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
S-so I have the whole cafe to myself?!
How
princessly!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We made sure to pick the perfect

conversation partner to join you, so I'm
sure the
program will turn out great!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Thanks for tuning in to today's episode of Meet the Racers! Our guests today are...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I'm Kawakami Princess! Should I
stand in
the middle?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Obviously not!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
After all, today's main star is me:
Magical Girl
Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're my discussion partner?! R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(It's Sweep Tosho. She's the Umamusume
who won
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
that Kawakami
Princess and I watched
together.)

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. You're both the stars of our

program. ♪

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
To kick things off: Sweep Tosho! As the
Shuka
Sho marvel, do you have any
advice for
Kawakami Princess?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nope!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why should I give advice to some
hooligan
princess who's way in over her
head?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-wha... How dare you call a princess a

hooligan?! Who taught you such a
word?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's none of your beeswax,
Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're not getting any advice from me.
Not even
if you drop to your knees and
cry! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ohhh. I seeeee.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Sweep. I've realized why you're
being
mean to me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The truth is... you don't even have any advice that could help me, do you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm already far too powerful, after all,
and poor
losers only know how to
criticize... I understand
your frustration, I
really do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! Don't you look down on me!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
P-please, you two! Let's get a hold of
ourselves,
shall we?! Umm... On to our
next segment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm standing beside the TV producer and

watching the program from off camera,
when...

text_block_list.name: Lady Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Who are those two? They're bickering
without a
sliver of dignity.

text_block_list.name: Lady Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the magical girl and the savage

Umamusume. Remember what the
savage one did
at the Japanese Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Kawakami and Sweep's furious
exchange
can be heard even outside the
cafe. Passersby are
beginning to peer
inside with puzzled expressions.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's no problem. If there's
anything you
want cut, just let us know.
But I'm personally fine
with it as is!

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to capture a natural
conversation
between the two of them.
Aren't they both so
strong and
fascinating?

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume don't need glitz or glamour
to shine
in the Tiara tour. That's the
message I want to
convey to our viewers.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's a little embarrassing, but my
friend's
daughter is an Umamusume. She
always wanted to
enter the Tiara tour,
but before she could...

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
She gave up because she didn't think
she was
glamorous enough. Her friends
in elementary
school told her the Tiara
wouldn't suit her.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what that's even supposed
to mean.
But I guess it was profound
enough to steal away
the courage she
needed to pursue her dream.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I'm really mad now! Listen up,
precious
princess! You'd better enter the
Queen Elizabeth
II Cup this year!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was already planning on it! And
you know
what I'm also planning on?
Strolling into first
place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there's no way I'll lose, so I hope
you're
prepared to fall to the ground
crying!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who'll be crying! On the
day of the
race, you'll get a taste of my
most powerful
magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their squabbling shows no signs of dying
down,
and in the end, Kawakami doesn't
get any advice
for the Shuka Sho.
However...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami and Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this at the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the episode hits the air, the
vigorous
exchange between the two
racers becomes a big
hit among viewers.
choice_data_list: （2人とも生き生きしてるなあ……）
choice_data_list_en: ï¼Both of them look so full of life...ï¼
ï¼Both of them look so full of life...ï¼

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, I'm watching a
recording of the
program when...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I've got some fan letters here
for
Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. I had some documents I
needed
to give you anyway, so I thought
I'd do it all at
once.
choice_data_list: わざわざありがとうございます！
choice_data_list_en: Thank you so much for going out of your way!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this at the Queen Elizabeth
II Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this that TV program from the
other day?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They're both so wonderful and full of
energy.
Hehe, maybe that's why there
are so many fan
letters coming in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After checking the documents regarding
the
Shuka Sho, I open the paper bag
containing
Kawakami Princess's fan
letters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I check through them to make sure
there aren't
any letters for other
Umamusume mixed in by
mistake, I spot
an envelope that reads...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, it's not even a one-off.
Several of
the fan letters are addressed
to both of us.
choice_data_list: 『カワカミプリンセスとトレーナー宛』？
choice_data_list_en: 'Addressed to Kawakami Princess and her Trainer'?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open one up to read, yet all that's
written inside
is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "You're the worst."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! ...Oh? Why do you
look so
flustered?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Are you hiding something from
me? Oh my.
Whatever could it be, I
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come ooon, you should know that a
princess is
very perceptive! I'll have to
pretend I didn't see
anything. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You actually prepared a surprise
present for when
I win the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup. ♪ That's my
trainer—so
considerate. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my surprise at Kawakami Princess'
sudden
entrance, I panicked and hid the
letters from
her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hate to invade her privacy, but I want
to check
the rest of the letters before
handing them over. I
pack the bag deep
into a cardboard box.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may be a pro athlete, but she's also
still a
sensitive young teenager. At times
like this, I
have a duty as an adult to
protect her.
